flags.message: The provisioned petition references an appendix containing the lower-court orders and government motion, but its supplied text ends at printed page 38 without those appendix materials. The manifest reports 48 pages, nonempty text, and no truncation; this may reflect a separate appendix filing rather than an extraction error. Forecast uses the petitioner's account of the jurisdictional and recusal rulings, not independently inspected orders. No target-case outcome was sought or encountered.
